source.classification: 官方 OpenAPI 原样摘取 BaseInput 与 ImageSize schema

seed.title: Seed
seed.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model
            will output the same image every time.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: URL of image to be used for relighting

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

initial_latent.title: Initial Latent
initial_latent.description: Provide lighting conditions for the model

guidance_scale.title: Guidance scale (CFG)
guidance_scale.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
            the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

mask_image_url.title: Mask Image Url
mask_image_url.description: URL of mask to be used for ic-light conditioning image

background_threshold.title: Background Threshold
background_threshold.description: Threshold for the background removal algorithm. A high threshold will produce sharper masks. Note: This parameter is currently deprecated and has no effect on the output.

highres_denoise.title: Highres Denoise
highres_denoise.description: Strength for high-resolution pass. Only used if enable_hr_fix is True.

cfg.title: Cfg
cfg.description: The real classifier-free-guidance scale for the generation.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: The size of the generated image.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

examples: perfume bottle in a volcano surrounded by lava.
prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt to generate an image from.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

num_images.title: Num Images
num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.
